material.content: {"styles":[{"range":[0,34],"size":4.55,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"It's okay. We had\nto tie her down."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,43],"size":4.55,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"I need a mirror. Now!\nAt least 3 feet high."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,48],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"Most cops go 20 years\nwithout firing their guns."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,42],"size":4.55,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"Why do I always know\nwhere these guys are?"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,56],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"I'm wondering, is there\nsomething wrong with me, Father?"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,49],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"God has a plan for you.\nHe has a plan for us all."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,52],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"You mustn't let your faith\nbe overshadowed by guilt."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,37],"size":4.55,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"And now I'm gonna\nbe done in by this."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,48],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"You saved me before, you\ncan do it again, right?"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,43],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"Twenty years ago, you\ndidn't wanna be here."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,52],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"Now you don't wanna leave.\nYeah, that's a good idea."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,39],"size":4.55,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"- She fell from the\nroof? - She jumped."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,41],"size":4.55,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"I know it's hard to\naccept. She was sick."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,64],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"The big score? The mother Iode?\nThe one you've been waiting for?"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,51],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"I just pulled a soldier\ndemon out of a little girl."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,42],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"Looked like it was\ntrying to come through."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,49],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"We're finger puppets to\nthem, John, not doorways."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,61],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"They can work us, but they can't\ncome through onto our plane."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,55],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"Check the scrolls anyway.\nSee if there's any precedent."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,63],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"- That's not the way this works.\n- Haven't I served him enough?"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,46],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"- What does he want from\nme? - Only the usual."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,47],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"- I believe, for Christ's\nsake. - No, you know."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,49],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"I never asked to see. I\nwas born with this curse."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,62],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"A gift, John. One that you've\nsquandered on selfish endeavors."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,55],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"I'm pulling demons out of\nlittle girls. Who's that for?"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,64],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"Everything you've ever done,\nyou've only ever done for yourself."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,43],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"To earn your way back\ninto his good graces."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,35],"size":4.55,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"Who goes up, who\ngoes down and why."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,62],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"Not some angry half-breed. A\nfull-fledged demon, on our plane."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,55],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"Clearly I do not have to\nremind you that is impossible."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,49],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"trying to chew its way\nout through a little girl."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,44],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"John, demons stay in\nhell, angels in heaven,"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,70],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"Thanks for the history lesson,\nMidnite. You've been a tremendous help."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,66],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"John, forgetting the fact that it\nwould almost certainly kill you,"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,58],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"And as long as the balance is\nmaintained, I take no sides."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,56],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"She was a patient at Ravenscar.\nShe jumped off the roof."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,67],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"Yeah. What kind of mental patient\nkills herself? That's just crazy."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,64],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"Just before my sister was committed,\nshe became deeply paranoid."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,49],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"Now, I think someone got\nto her, Mr. Constantine."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,57],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"I think they brainwashed her\ninto stepping off that roof."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,48],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"Don't worry. Happens to\neveryone the first time."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,34],"size":4.55,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"Was it supposed\nto be hot or cold?"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,39],"size":4.55,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"- How about the cat?\n- Duck? Yeah, why?"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,44],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"- You think that's\nstrange. - Cats are good."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,37],"size":4.55,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"- You were twins.\n- What did you say?"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,54],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"- You tried to kill yourself.\n- I didn't try anything."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,51],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"Take it from me, two minutes\nin hell is a lifetime."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,44],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"I knew all the things\nI could see were real."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,64],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"Heaven and hell are right here.\nBehind every wall, every window."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,58],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"The world behind the world,\nand we're smack in the middle."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,50],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"Angels and demons can't\ncross over onto our plane."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,42],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"So instead we get what\nI call half-breeds."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,47],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"I deport their sorry ass\nstraight back to hell."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,50],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"but I've been hoping to\nget enough to ensure my..."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,56],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"When I die, the rules say\nI've got just one place to go."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,62],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"Maybe she left something else.\nNot something a cop would find."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,53],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"You were her twin, Angela.\nTwins tend to think alike."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,46],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"- I'm not like my sister.\n- But you were once."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,66],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"When you were kids. When you'd\nspend every second with each other."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,67],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"You'd start a sentence, she'd finish\nit. You'd get hurt, she'd cry."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,66],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"- That was a long time ago. - That\nkind of bond doesn't disappear."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,71],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"\"The sins of the father would only\nbe exceeded by the sins of the son.\""}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,42],"size":4.55,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"- Whose son? - But he\ncan't cross over, B."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,51],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"- Impossible to cross over.\n- Whose son? God's son?"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,39],"size":4.55,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"No, the other one.\nDevil had a son too."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,49],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"This is the sign of Mammon,\nthe son of the devil."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,58],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"No, wait, wait, wait. I'm\nreading. Seems to be a loophole."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,73],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"It says first Mammon would have to\npossess a very, very powerful psychic."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,51],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"To cross over, Mammon would\nneed divine assistance."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,49],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"To cross over, Mammon\nwould need the help of God."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,70],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"I know you've never had much faith,\nyou've never had much reason to..."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,46],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"But that doesn't mean\nthat we don't have faith"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,71],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"By the time we were 10, they started\nforcing her to take antipsychotics"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,79],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"They would come for her and she'd look\nat me, and she'd say to me, \"Tell them.\""}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,60],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"\"Why don't you tell them, Angie,\nthat you can see them too?\""}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,57],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"Normally, only a portion of\nthe body has to be suspended,"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,62],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"- What do you mean lie down? -\nYou have to be fully submerged."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,38],"size":4.55,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"- For how long? -\nAs long as it takes."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,52],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"I've always known. I've\nalways known where they are."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,57],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"How's Mammon crossing over,\nyou half-breed piece of shit?"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,56],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"You can't cheat it this time.\nYou're going back to hell."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,56],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"- What are you doing? - I'm\nreading you your last rites."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,44],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"You do know what it is\nto truly be forgiven?"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,39],"size":4.55,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"To be welcomed into\nthe Kingdom of God."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,34],"size":4.55,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"I'd love to be a\nfly on that wall."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,39],"size":4.55,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"You're not a priest.\nYou have no power."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,40],"size":4.55,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"Just tell me how\nMammon is crossing over"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,37],"size":4.55,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"and you can go back\nto your shithole."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,40],"size":4.55,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"will give birth to\nthe son of the devil."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,71],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"Jesus didn't die nailed to a cross.\nHe was killed by a soldier's spear."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,51],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"I'm a Catholic, John. I\nknow the Crucifixion story."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,35],"size":4.55,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"I drew out the\nsister as you asked."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,58],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"Beeman said Mammon needed\ndivine assistance to cross over."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,42],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"He still has to locate\na powerful psychic."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,56],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"You're the only one still\nplaying by the rules, Midnite."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,62],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"And while you've been imitating\nSwitzerland, people are dying."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,60],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"Hennessy, Beeman, they were\nyour friends once too, remember?"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,35],"size":4.55,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"- Any luck? - That's\na word for it."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,71],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"There's no use sitting on the bench\nif you're not ready to play, right?"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,67],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"You wouldn't have one of those\nenchanted crosses here in a cabinet."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,59],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"John, no offense. I just don't\nthink that it's a great idea"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,62],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"you going on a solo mission to\nsave the world. That's my vote."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,44],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"I don't know what pops\nthinks, but that's..."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,67],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"A birth like this, they're definitely\ngonna be guarding her, right?"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,66],"size":4.25,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"We can get through them. I mean,\nthat cross has gotta work, right?"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,40],"size":4.55,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9490196078431372,0.9529411764705882,0.9607843137254902]}}}}],"text":"It's not always like\nit is in the books."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,19],"size":5.720000000000001,"bold":true,"italic":true,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9764705882352941,0.9058823529411765,0.8980392156862745]}}}},{"range":[19,25],"size":6.063200000000001,"bold":true,"italic":true,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[1,0.1411764705882353,0.10980392156862745]}}}},{"range":[25,52],"size":5.720000000000001,"bold":true,"italic":true,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9764705882352941,0.9058823529411765,0.8980392156862745]}}}}],"text":"In Mexico's ruins, Manuel\nuncovers an ancient spear…"}

material.recognize_text:
From then on, an ordinary
life quietly twists.
material.text:
From then on, an ordinary
life quietly twists.

material.content: {"styles":[{"range":[0,21],"size":5.720000000000001,"bold":true,"italic":true,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9764705882352941,0.9058823529411765,0.8980392156862745]}}}},{"range":[21,32],"size":6.063200000000001,"bold":true,"italic":true,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[1,0.1411764705882353,0.10980392156862745]}}}},{"range":[32,64],"size":5.720000000000001,"bold":true,"italic":true,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9764705882352941,0.9058823529411765,0.8980392156862745]}}}}],"text":"In Los Angeles, John Constantine\nenters a possessed girl's room."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,34],"size":5,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[1,1,1]}}}},{"range":[34,39],"size":5.300000000000001,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[1,0.9450980392156862,0.6509803921568628]}}}},{"range":[39,52],"size":5,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[1,1,1]}}}}],"text":"He skips the prayer and\nreads the signs left behind."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,59],"size":5.5,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[1,1,1]}}}}],"text":"He should be praying, yet he\nsearches with suspicious calm."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,26],"size":5.35,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[1,1,1]}}}},{"range":[26,43],"size":5.671,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[1,0.9450980392156862,0.6509803921568628]}}}},{"range":[43,47],"size":5.35,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[1,1,1]}}}}],"text":"Isabel jumped, but Angela\nrefuses to accept it."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,49],"size":5,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[1,1,1]}}}},{"range":[49,54],"size":5.300000000000001,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[1,0.9450980392156862,0.6509803921568628]}}}},{"range":[54,55],"size":5,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[1,1,1]}}}}],"text":"The demon's name matters less\nthan who broke the rules."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,50],"size":5.5,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[1,1,1]}}}}],"text":"After the attack, he turns\nto the neutral Midnite."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,6],"size":5.35,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[1,1,1]}}}},{"range":[6,12],"size":5.671,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[1,0.9450980392156862,0.6509803921568628]}}}},{"range":[12,45],"size":5.35,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[1,1,1]}}}}],"text":"Here, Heaven and Hell\nagree to stop fighting."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,9],"size":5.720000000000001,"bold":true,"italic":true,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9764705882352941,0.9058823529411765,0.8980392156862745]}}}},{"range":[9,15],"size":6.063200000000001,"bold":true,"italic":true,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[1,0.1411764705882353,0.10980392156862745]}}}},{"range":[15,58],"size":5.720000000000001,"bold":true,"italic":true,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9764705882352941,0.9058823529411765,0.8980392156862745]}}}}],"text":"To trace Isabel, Constantine\ngathers her things—and a cat."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,55],"size":5,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[1,1,1]}}}}],"text":"The search leaves evidence\nbehind and follows the dead."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,54],"size":5.5,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[1,1,1]}}}}],"text":"Tap water, a cat, and a trip\nto Hell. Oddly practical."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,52],"size":5,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[1,1,1]}}}}],"text":"Hell looks like a ruined\nworld layered over reality."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,5],"size":5.720000000000001,"bold":true,"italic":true,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9764705882352941,0.9058823529411765,0.8980392156862745]}}}},{"range":[5,11],"size":6.063200000000001,"bold":true,"italic":true,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[1,0.1411764705882353,0.10980392156862745]}}}},{"range":[11,47],"size":5.720000000000001,"bold":true,"italic":true,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9764705882352941,0.9058823529411765,0.8980392156862745]}}}}],"text":"Then Beeman's voice dies,\nand they race to him."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,56],"size":5,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[1,1,1]}}}}],"text":"Angela never wanted the\ngift—only a way to reach Isabel."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,18],"size":5.35,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[1,1,1]}}}},{"range":[18,23],"size":5.671,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[1,0.9450980392156862,0.6509803921568628]}}}},{"range":[23,48],"size":5.35,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[1,1,1]}}}}],"text":"Once she sees the truth,\nit starts looking back."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,21],"size":5.720000000000001,"bold":true,"italic":true,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9764705882352941,0.9058823529411765,0.8980392156862745]}}}},{"range":[21,27],"size":6.063200000000001,"bold":true,"italic":true,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[1,0.1411764705882353,0.10980392156862745]}}}},{"range":[27,54],"size":5.720000000000001,"bold":true,"italic":true,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9764705882352941,0.9058823529411765,0.8980392156862745]}}}}],"text":"Her senses restored, Angela\nfollows the demon's trace…"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,60],"size":5,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[1,1,1]}}}}],"text":"She is no longer the client,\nbut the eyes hunting the demon."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,48],"size":5.35,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[1,1,1]}}}}],"text":"The same gift makes Angela\nboth clue and target."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,7],"size":5.300000000000001,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[1,0.9450980392156862,0.6509803921568628]}}}},{"range":[7,52],"size":5,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[1,1,1]}}}}],"text":"Neutrality now sounds like\nan excuse to stand still."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,11],"size":6.063200000000001,"bold":true,"italic":true,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[1,0.1411764705882353,0.10980392156862745]}}}},{"range":[11,57],"size":5.720000000000001,"bold":true,"italic":true,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9764705882352941,0.9058823529411765,0.8980392156862745]}}}}],"text":"Constantine and Chas race to\nthe hospital holding Angela…"}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,37],"size":5.35,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[1,1,1]}}}},{"range":[37,46],"size":5.671,"bold":true,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[1,0.9450980392156862,0.6509803921568628]}}}},{"range":[46,47],"size":5.35,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[1,1,1]}}}}],"text":"The enemy thins out, but\nso does the time left."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,51],"size":5,"bold":false,"italic":false,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[1,1,1]}}}}],"text":"Mammon's arrival is no\nlonger prophecy. It is here."}

{"styles":[{"range":[0,33],"size":5.720000000000001,"bold":true,"italic":true,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9764705882352941,0.9058823529411765,0.8980392156862745]}}}},{"range":[33,44],"size":6.063200000000001,"bold":true,"italic":true,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[1,0.1411764705882353,0.10980392156862745]}}}},{"range":[44,55],"size":5.720000000000001,"bold":true,"italic":true,"underline":false,"fill":{"alpha":1,"content":{"render_type":"solid","solid":{"alpha":1,"color":[0.9764705882352941,0.9058823529411765,0.8980392156862745]}}}}],"text":"With no answer from either\nside, Constantine pushes on…"}
